primaryChecks.text: The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt. The king’s merchants received them in droves, each drove at a price.
primaryChecks.previousContext: The king made silver as common as stones in Jerusalem, and cedars as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.
primaryChecks.nextContext: A chariot was imported from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for one hundred fifty shekels; and so they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and to the kings of Syria.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 候補索引の用例と固定本文を照合し、場所との関係は文脈上の対応としてのみ扱う。
